title: Senior Marketing Program Operations Manager
searchText: Senior Marketing Program Operations Manager MongoDB MongoDB is seeking a strategic and outcomes-focused Senior Program Operations Manager to support the leadership and execution of the Developer Relations organization. Reporting to the Head of Product & Technical Marketing (PTM) Program Operations and embedded with the Developer Relations leadership team, this role serves as a trusted partner responsible for operationalizing priorities, driving alignment, and ensuring strong execution across DevRel. This role blends strategic support, operational execution, and coordination of DevRel content and editorial workflows. You will help ensure priorities are clear, initiatives move forward efficiently, and DevRel content is delivered with quality and consistency through well-defined systems, workflows, and operating rigor. We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model. Given the global nature of the Developer Relations leadership team across the U.S., EMEA, and APAC regions, this position requires a consistent late-day working schedule, with core hours spanning approximately 2pm-10pm local time to ensure regular overlap with U.S.-based leadership and cross-functional partners. What You’ll Do Strategy & Execution Support Partner closely with the Head of Developer Relations to support planning, prioritization, and execution of key initiatives in line with strategic objectives Translate DevRel priorities into clear plans, timelines, and tracked work across systems Prepare summaries, updates, and materials to support leadership reviews and decision-making, and build automations where necessary Drive follow-through across DevRel workstreams and operating rhythms Content & Editorial Ownership Own editorial standards, quality, and operational enforcement across DevRel and executive-level goals Serve as the primary owner for editorial guidance and its integration into content workflows, including best practices for writing for search engines and LLMs Ensure content/editorial standards are consistently applied across DevRel output, and ensure tracking and attribution are accounted for and visible to leadership Content Operations & Workflow Management Own the systems and workflows that power DevRel content execution in Wrike, including task structures, templates, and documentation Ensure content initiatives are well-scoped, prioritized, and delivered on time Partner with PTM Program Operations to continuously improve workflows and reduce friction Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with Developer Advocates, Product Marketing, Competitive Intelligence, Program Operations, and Marketing Operations Drive alignment between DevRel execution and broader PTM priorities Requirements 5+ years of experience in marketing, content operations, program management, or a related role Experience supporting senior leaders and complex, cross-functional initiatives Strong editorial judgment and written communication skills Proven ability to manage multiple projects and drive execution in ambiguous environments Experience owning and improving workflows and operational systems (Wrike or similar tools preferred) Highly organized, proactive, and collaborative About MongoDB MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the database for the AI era, enabling innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified database platform, the most widely available, globally distributed database on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud database and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. With offices worldwide and over 60,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software. Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy , we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB , and help us make an impact on the world! MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter. MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.
